items.notes: Count-equality counterexample, digest limits, observation boundary and reconciliation/repair/evidence are covered. Missing the versioned sequence of safe intermediate states (S0-S4) and the new-only persisted-effects forward-repair walkthrough.

Discord failure mechanism, fan-out pressure and the architecture shift are supported. The evaluation-set-before-vector-model claim is absent, and ownership/cell separation is only partially reflected.

Correctly explains what an unlimited submission queue fails to bound and prescribes queue/admission limits, but does not cover the capacity-and-correctness decision matrix or the four distinct concurrency boundaries; only the admission-reject contract touches the rejection criteria.
Sampling limits, the evidence gap, audit/lineage reconciliation and signal-level measurement are covered. The aggregation-loses-information-by-design claim is absent.
Edge meaning, provenance, traversal bounds and the path-is-not-proof claim are covered. Aggregation information loss and token/credential boundaries are absent.

Covers static hosting, cache invalidation and purge, origin protection, version retention and edge ownership. Valet Key is present through private/edge-signed asset key plus authorization contract and revocation testing.
Anti-corruption-layer ownership failure, semantic adapters and the equipment-catalogue open/available example are covered. Self-Contained Service is not addressed.
Static hosting and cache invalidation/freshness are covered. TTL-based expiration is only name-dropped in a list of per-request decisions, not substantively covered.

Async request-reply, callback delivery and rejection when a synchronous response suffices are covered. Transactional Outbox, Claim Check and the scarce-resource/acceptance-outcome claim are absent. One cited section does not resolve.
Provenance fields, what replay proves and the cross-platform limit are covered. The route heading is a navigational index, not a substantive claim; no substantive core claim is missing.
Fail-closed ordering and the provenance link from inputs/hashes to the run record are covered. Applying the decision constraints and the conservation case are absent.
Structural identifier, link and hash checks are covered, as is the hash-binding diagram. Reproducibility-and-replay and the ten-rules mapping are absent.
Timeout reset, per-attempt deadline, retry state and the relevant determinism rules are covered. Retry amplification (attempts/offered-load) is not addressed.
